name: @openclinxr/xr-sync-client
purpose: Lean headset sync client: intents out with per-intent ack or reject, encounter state in via reflection-decoded patches.

exportSummaries.AckResult: Resolved outcome for an applied intent, with round-trip time.
exportSummaries.EncounterSnapshot: Plain view of synced encounter state delivered to onState.
exportSummaries.IntentKind: Client-to-server intent kinds, mirroring the server contract.
exportSummaries.IntentPayload: JSON payload carried by one intent.
exportSummaries.IntentResult: Either outcome of one sent intent.
exportSummaries.RejectResult: Resolved outcome for a rejected intent.
exportSummaries.SnapshotActor: Plain view of one synced actor.
exportSummaries.SnapshotLearner: Plain view of one synced learner, including intent cursor.
exportSummaries.SyncConnection: Live headset-side connection: intents out, snapshots in.
exportSummaries.connect: Join the encounter room at url and wire intent, snapshot, and reconnect handling.
